sin.name: blank-string-on-the-wire
sin.description: A string sent over the wire that the frontend reads as absent when it is blank.
sin.rule: A field that crosses the wire says absence in its TYPE; never ship a blank for the far side to decode as missing.
sin.suggestion: `?string $x = null` on the shape, and the reader asks `x == null` — one spelling of absence, agreed by both sides.
